Why HCP

Quality you can document, supply you can plan around

Haryana Chemical & Pharmaceuticals connects reputable chemical producers with formulators who need verified compliance, accurate paperwork and dependable dispatch.

Strict grade segregation

Pharmacopoeial (IP, BP, USP) and technical grades are sourced and supplied separately — never interchanged.

COA & batch documentation

Manufacturer Certificates of Analysis confirm assay, impurity limits and appearance for each lot.

Traceable manufacturer sources

Every product lists its documented make — Godrej, Savita, Proto Chemical, Manali, Sukhjit and more.

Honest, enquiry-based pricing

No fabricated online prices. Each quote reflects real volumes, packaging and freight to your plant.

More about HCP
How it works

From cart to quotation in four steps

Built for purchase teams: one enquiry for many products, answered with real prices and documents.

  1. 01

    Find your products

    Search the catalogue by chemical name, grade, manufacturer or application.

  2. 02

    Add to cart

    Add every material you need and set the quantity and unit in your enquiry cart.

  3. 03

    Send one enquiry

    Share your company and delivery details. No payment — the enquiry is emailed to our desk.

  4. 04

    Receive your quotation

    We confirm grade and stock, then email the price, delivery terms and batch COA.
